purpose: Exploratory W-01 first render and warmed runtime stages at passing offered loads
limitations: Only 5/s and 20/s are measured; this does not establish maximum throughput or overload behavior
Two short repetitions on an uncontrolled Windows laptop are exploratory
Logical CPU masks do not establish physical-core separation; no memory limit is enforced
The first control request includes connection, client construction, and response decoding costs
Initial request association relies on controlled ordering and the server's initial counter, not a response-ID header
Stage intervals are wall time, including asynchronous waits; they do not establish isolate-thread CPU attribution
Stage statistics use one shared server export-completion cohort, without a direct client/server latency join
The console helper and controller are outside the server's CPU accounting
Coverage reconciliation assumes this fixed app only returns HTTP 503 on host admission failure
Production application/browser checks are reused; no personalized-data isolation claim
